content: प्रवर्तक {%a.%} (-र्तिका|{%f.%}) .²1 Setting on foot, founding. .²2 Advancing, promoting, furthering. .²3 Producing, causing, … कृतिसाध्यताज्ञानं वा प्रवर्तकमिति जरन्नैयायिकाः. .²4 Prompting, urging, inducing, instigating (in a bad sense). .{@-कः@} .²1 An originator, founder, author. .²2 A prompter, instigator. .²3 An arbiter, umpire. .{@-कम्@} The entrance of a character on the stage.
